findings.highlight: as a I answer.
findings.evidenceJa: はっきりと返答した
findings.governingReading: Shirou answers clearly while looking directly at the priest.
findings.explanation: “As a I answer” inserts an extra article.

findings.highlight: seeing your regret is enough for me
findings.evidenceJa: その罪悪感だけでも収穫
findings.governingReading: Kotomine treats the guilt visible in Rin as his consolation for Shirou’s withdrawal.
findings.explanation: Rin’s guilt becomes regret.

findings.highlight: I hear the sound of tearing flesh.
findings.evidenceJa: 腕の内部に他人の指が潜り込んでくる
findings.governingReading: Shirou hears a wet movement as another person’s fingers pass inside his arm, but the arm has no wound.
findings.explanation: Fingers spiritually entering an uninjured arm acquire the sound of flesh tearing.

findings.highlight: removing tumors without cutting the patient up...like magic
findings.evidenceJa: 手品みたいに腫瘍を取り除く
findings.governingReading: Shirou recalls tumor removal performed like a stage trick without cutting the body.
findings.explanation: A conjuring trick becomes “magic” inside a discussion already distinguishing magecraft.

findings.highlight: illegal and used only in uncivilized parts of the world
findings.evidenceJa: 未開の地で使われる外法
findings.governingReading: Shirou calls spiritual treatment an outside or forbidden art used in undeveloped regions.
findings.explanation: An illicit or heterodox art becomes legally “illegal.”

findings.highlight: It matters not whether I perform expert or basic magecraft.
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術の貴賎など気にするな
findings.governingReading: Kotomine says once he is already disqualified as a priest, Shirou should not care whether a form of magic is noble or base.
findings.explanation: Differences of rank or worth among magic become expert versus basic technique.

findings.highlight: I'm basically betraying her.
findings.evidenceJa: それは彼女に対する裏切りだ
findings.governingReading: He judges unilateral erasure of the contract as betrayal without qualification.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s act being a betrayal of Saber becomes “basically” a betrayal.

findings.highlight: I have no intention of killing anyone.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺は殺し合いをする気はない
findings.governingReading: Shirou says his decision is unchanged because he will not take part in killing one another.
findings.explanation: Refusal to participate in mutual killing becomes merely having no intention of killing anyone.

findings.highlight: my leg hurts like it's been shattered to a thousand pieces
findings.evidenceJa: 足が千切れそうなほど痛む
findings.governingReading: The bones are cracked and the legs hurt as though they may be torn away, though they remain attached.
findings.explanation: Pain as if the legs might tear off becomes pain as if they shattered into a thousand pieces.

findings.highlight: I try to ignore the pain and focus all my concentration
findings.evidenceJa: 痛みで朦朧とする意識をしぼって
findings.governingReading: He squeezes his dim awareness together despite the pain to look up at Saber.
findings.explanation: Shirou concentrating through a pain-clouded consciousness becomes ignoring pain.

findings.highlight: Even if I changed my mind right now, I wouldn't do it.
findings.evidenceJa: 今から考えを改めたところで俺には出来ない
findings.governingReading: Even if he reversed his decision now, he says he could not do it; his prior refusal means only defeat awaits.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s belief that he cannot serve as Master becomes that he simply would not.

findings.highlight: I was defeated.
findings.evidenceJa: どんな形であれ、俺の心は折れた
findings.governingReading: Regardless of form, his resolve has broken after rejecting the fight.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s heart or spirit being broken becomes having been defeated.

findings.highlight: If I refused to fight once, so I'll certainly do the same a second time.
findings.evidenceJa: 一度でも戦いを拒んだのなら、必ず二度目が訪れる
findings.governingReading: Having refused once, Shirou believes a second refusal will certainly follow.
findings.explanation: “If I refused...so I’ll” combines incompatible conditional and result markers.

findings.highlight: I shall never see you again
findings.evidenceJa: 再び会う事はないでしょうが
findings.governingReading: She says they likely will not meet again but prays for his survival.
findings.explanation: Saber’s expectation that they probably will not meet again becomes certainty.

findings.highlight: I smother it before I embarrass myself.
findings.evidenceJa: その愚行を抑え込んだ
findings.governingReading: He involuntarily starts to call out, then restrains what he regards as a foolish act.
findings.explanation: Shirou suppressing the foolish urge to call Saber back becomes avoiding embarrassment.

findings.highlight: the sound of a girl speaking in a hushed voice
findings.evidenceJa: くすぐるような少女の声
findings.governingReading: Shirou raises his head at the girl’s voice, whose quality feels teasing or ticklish against him.
findings.explanation: Illya’s tickling, teasing voice becomes a hushed voice.

findings.highlight: And then...I'm not sure.
findings.evidenceJa: 爆ぜた
findings.governingReading: Before Shirou can perceive, speak, or flee, his body or experience bursts apart.
findings.explanation: The instantaneous “burst” beginning Berserker’s attack becomes uncertainty.

findings.highlight: I use my one working arm to grasp at the asphalt
findings.evidenceJa: 動く手でアスファルトをつかんで
findings.governingReading: Because the legs are broken, he grips the asphalt with the limb or limbs that can still move and pulls backward.
findings.explanation: Shirou drags himself with his still-moving hands or arms; English leaves only one working arm.

findings.highlight: I'm going to give you a little hand!
findings.evidenceJa: わたしがちょっとだけ手を貸してあげました
findings.governingReading: She reveals that she has already helped a little so Shirou will remain conscious until his head is crushed.
findings.explanation: Illya’s already-completed intervention to preserve consciousness becomes a future offer of help.

findings.highlight: writhing like a little bug
findings.evidenceJa: 生き物としてのたうちまわれる
findings.governingReading: Illya says her intervention lets him continue writhing as a living thing despite the damage.
findings.explanation: Writhing as a living creature becomes writhing “like a little bug.”

findings.highlight: It flattens my entire body like a sheet of paper.
findings.evidenceJa: 体の下が二次元になってしまって
findings.governingReading: Sword pressure crushes the part beneath him into a two-dimensional, unbelievably flat form.
findings.explanation: The lower part of Shirou’s body becoming planar expands into his entire body flattening.

findings.highlight: Yet somehow I cling to consciousness.
findings.evidenceJa: 意識がどうしても消えてくれない
findings.governingReading: His body and nerves want death, but his consciousness will not go out despite him.
findings.explanation: Consciousness refusing to disappear because of Illya’s intervention becomes Shirou clinging to it.

findings.highlight: I feel then, down to my soul, that I'm going to die here.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分はここで殺されると完全に理解した
findings.governingReading: Once hope freezes, Shirou fully understands that he will be killed there.
findings.explanation: Complete understanding of imminent death becomes a feeling “down to my soul.”
